## Current objective
Fix double-counted refunds in `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`. Tenacity migration, S3 decommission, and PDF optimization are paused.

## Ruled-out approaches
Six-hour Celery `visibility_timeout` hid stuck jobs. Invalid-limit responses use HTTP 422 and `detail`, not `items`.

## Plan and progress
- [pending] Diagnose and fix reconciliation refund double-counting; next command not supplied.
- [paused] Tenacity migration and S3 decommission.
- [done] PDF baseline: `12 passed, 1 skipped in 1.84s`.
